confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Japanese price levels, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July rates vary by date and room type, with plausible bounds of about 24-38 (dorm), 55-90 (private hostel double), 60-100 (1-star double) and 105-175 (3-star double). Cocktail and wine anchors are set from the local price relationship to draft beer because direct knowledge of Nara bar and wine-by-the-glass prices is limited. The FX observation came from a web search summary of rba.gov.au results; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Nara is a smaller historic tourist city in the Kansai region, close to Kyoto and Osaka. Restaurant and cafe anchors follow typical Japanese price levels for mid-sized sightseeing cities, set near or slightly below Kyoto. Accommodation anchors are set below Kyoto, reflecting the general pattern that Nara hotel and hostel rates run below Kyoto's.
